title: Land of Light NPC Mannequins
description: Resource Packs that replaces player textures to be Ultras from the Land of Light.
body:
![Display of Skins in this texture pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f4e8bf067abe59193541a91fa6af680ef89b4c93.jpeg)
## Description
This Resource Pack replaces the nine default player textures and therefore the mannequins to look like background Ultras from the movie _Mega Monster Battle: Ultra Galaxy Legend_. Each come in Wide and Slim arm sizes.

Can still be used on versions before mannequins were added but after 1.19.3 when new default player skins were added.

Uses [ETF] Entity Texture Features for mob variants. Still usable without, but won't see variants only the default Alex or basic nine player skins.

## Spawn egg command

Alex slim (default variants)
```
/give @p allay_spawn_egg[lore=[[{text:"Swatch!",italic:false}]],entity_data={id:mannequin}]
```
Steve wide (Ultra heroes variants)

```
/give @p allay_spawn_egg[lore=[[{text:"Swatch!",italic:false}]],entity_data={id:mannequin,profile:{texture:"entity/player/wide/steve",model:wide}}]
```
